title: Setup Install checks
scope: Required tools and shell PATH readiness
encounter: Setup startup and retry after an Install failure
location: Automatic setup Install checks, recovery view and shell-change receipts
note: Healthy checks advance automatically. Missing optional harnesses do not block setup.
current: Source and scripted tests cover checks and recovery; deployed campaign proof remains release-bound. When SHELL is missing or empty, PATH repair selects the account login shell, falling back to zsh if the account shell is empty or the passwd lookup is unavailable. Startup-file write failures name the shell, file and recovery.
desired: Required tools work in a fresh login shell, with named recovery on failure and visible shell-file changes.
